description: Copying one timeline item's look onto others: a caption's or text layer's style, an overlay's look, or a clip's framing and grade.

actions.description: Give items the look of another item of the same kind, as Copy properties and Paste properties do. With fromItemID, copy that item's look first; without it, paste what the creator last copied. All itemIDs must be the same kind as the copied item: captions, text layers, overlays or clips. Position and timing are not part of an overlay's or clip's look.
